cleanmirror.title: CleanMirror
cleanmirror.help.window: Press F6 in-game to open or close the clean window. In OBS, add a Window Capture and pick the window by the title you set below.
cleanmirror.o.title: Window title
cleanmirror.o.title.t: This is the name OBS will show in its window list. Pick something you'll spot easily.
cleanmirror.o.fps.t: How often the stream updates. Frames in between cost nothing. In REDRAW mode this is your main performance setting: 30 means the extra world render happens 30 times a second.
cleanmirror.o.scaling.t: LETTERBOX keeps the shape and adds black bars. CROP fills the window and cuts the edges. STRETCH squashes it to fit.
cleanmirror.o.borderless.t: Slightly cleaner if you're capturing the whole window.
cleanmirror.help.nametags: Health-bar mods change the name text itself, and often force names onto every mob. VANILLA rebuilds every label from the entity's real name and shows it only where vanilla would. In REUSE mode this applies to both windows; in REDRAW it applies to the stream only.
cleanmirror.o.nametags.t1: VANILLA - real names only, shown only where vanilla shows them. Health bars, HP numbers and names-on-every-mob go away.
cleanmirror.o.teamcolors.t: Minecraft itself colours names by scoreboard team, so keeping that is still vanilla.
cleanmirror.help.hud: Untick anything the stream shouldn't see. Your own window never changes.
cleanmirror.help.mods: This list fills itself in: every mod that draws a named piece on your HUD appears here after you've played for a moment. Unticked = never on the stream. A mod you install tomorrow starts unticked. Press F7 in-game to see every piece by name.
cleanmirror.mods.empty: Nothing seen yet. Join a world, press F6 to open the clean window, play for a few seconds, then come back here - any mod that draws on your HUD will have appeared.
cleanmirror.mods.tip: Let %s draw on the clean feed. Tick this for things like the Simple Voice Chat microphone icon.
cleanmirror.o.allowlist.t: Allow one specific piece instead of a whole mod, e.g. voicechat:hud. You shouldn't need this.
cleanmirror.o.hideunnamed.t: Fabric's older HUD callback doesn't say which mod is drawing, so it can't be filtered per mod. ON = none of it on the stream (recommended). OFF = all of it.
cleanmirror.help.screens: Minecraft's own menus - pause, options, inventory, chests, resource-pack prompts, 'Connecting...', disconnect messages - show on the stream. Mod screens and mod toasts don't, unless you allow them.
cleanmirror.o.modscreens.t: Off by default, so opening a mod's config mid-stream doesn't put it on the feed.
cleanmirror.o.connscreens.t: Server resource pack prompts, 'Connecting...', disconnect messages.
cleanmirror.help.mode: REUSE copies your finished world picture: almost free, and removes every mod HUD. REDRAW draws the world a second time just for the stream: the stream gets plain nametags while you keep yours, and freecam can't reach it. Use the frame rate limit with REDRAW.
cleanmirror.o.mode.t1: REUSE - copy the world you already drew. Costs almost nothing. Nametag cleaning applies to BOTH windows, and freecam shows on the feed.
cleanmirror.o.mode.t2: REDRAW - draw the world again, clean. Nametag cleaning and freecam-proofing apply to the stream only. Costs a second world render each clean frame.
cleanmirror.help.redrawonly: The settings below only apply in REDRAW mode.
cleanmirror.o.fov.t: Give the stream its own field of view. 0 = same as yours. Sprinting and underwater zoom still apply on top.
cleanmirror.o.hidehand.t: Keeps your held item out of the clean feed. Nice for a cinematic look.
cleanmirror.o.freecam.t: The feed always shows the view from your body (or the mob you're spectating), even while a freecam mod moves your own camera. F5 third-person still mirrors.
cleanmirror.nocloth: CleanMirror's settings screen needs Cloth Config. Install Cloth Config for 1.21.11, or edit config/cleanmirror.json by hand. F6 opens the clean window either way.
cleanmirror.o.strict.t: Also skip anything other mods add while a label is drawn (extra lines, icons). Note: this hides Simple Voice Chat's speaker icon above heads too. The mic icon in the corner is unaffected.
cleanmirror.o.debug.t: Show the F3 screen (and the pie chart / FPS charts) on the stream whenever you have it open.
cleanmirror.o.toasts.t: Advancement, recipe, tutorial and system pop-ups in the corner.
cleanmirror.o.modtoasts.t: Pop-ups created by mods (for example a client announcing a module was toggled).
